field_file() {
 p=$1
 expected=$2
 test -f "$p"
 test ! -L "$p"
 test "$(wc -c < "$p")" = 5242880
 test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$expected"
 echo "FILE=$p"
 echo "SHA256=$expected"
 for off in 524298 524544 720906 721152 5242368; do
  echo "FIELD_OFFSET=$off"
  echo FIELD_BEGIN
  dd if="$p" bs=1 skip="$off" count=64 2>/dev/null | base64
  echo FIELD_END
 done
 test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$expected"
 echo FILE_END
}
